listening.title: The opening question of a QA interview

lines.speaker: Ms. Ngoc (Interviewer)
lines.text: Thank you for coming today, Khoa. To start, could you tell us a little about yourself?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: Of course. My name is Khoa, and I majored in information systems at the University of Economics.

lines.speaker: Ms. Ngoc (Interviewer)
lines.text: And what are you doing at the moment?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I am currently working as a QA engineer at a fintech company. I have been there for about three years.

lines.speaker: Ms. Ngoc (Interviewer)
lines.text: What kind of work do you do there?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I test our mobile banking app. Last year I built an automation test suite that cut our regression time from two days to four hours.

lines.speaker: Ms. Ngoc (Interviewer)
lines.text: That is impressive. Why are you interested in this position?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I am passionate about test automation, and your team is building a large e-commerce platform. I want to work at that scale.

lines.speaker: Ms. Ngoc (Interviewer)
lines.text: In one sentence, what would you bring to the table?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I would bring strong automation skills and a habit of finding problems early, before users see them.
